name: Weak Hashing Algorithm
description: Detects the use of weak hashing algorithms.

name: Hardcoded Password
description: Detects hardcoded passwords within source code.
recommendation: Store credentials securely using environment variables or a secrets manager.

name: Potential SQL Injection
description: Detects SQL queries built using string concatenation.
recommendation: Use parameterised queries or prepared statements.

name: Use of eval()
description: Detects the use of JavaScript eval().
recommendation: Avoid eval() and use safer alternatives.

name: Operating System Command Execution
description: Detects the use of child_process functions that execute operating system commands.
recommendation: Validate all user input and avoid executing operating system commands unless absolutely necessary.
